## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off for the DCO (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Skill metadata, plugin metadata, and documentation agree.
- [ ] New or changed scripts have repository-level tests.
- [ ] Remote operations preserve explicit authority, endpoint, and identity checks.
- [ ] No credentials, private content, local agent state, or generated caches are included.
- [ ] The changelog is updated for notable behavior changes.
